subject: Is there a way to extract spatial structure matrix from SPDE approach?

messages.author: 82728a1d353801f9
messages.subject: Is there a way to extract spatial structure matrix from SPDE approach?
parts:
Dear All, 

I am following the Paper of Michela Cameletti et al. (2013) and try to construct a spde model for my own spatio-temporal problem. Below is partial code I am using to implement SPDE model. My question is : Is there a way to extract the spatial structure matrix from SPDE approach???

Thanks a lot,

Xintong Li 


spde= inla.spde2.matern(mesh=mesh.dsfw, alpha=2)
A.estimate= inla.spde.make.A(mesh.dsfw,loc=a.loc, group=final.agg$season,n.group=144)

#############

field.indices =inla.spde.make.index("field",
                       n.spde=spde$n.spde,
                       n.group=144)

stk =inla.stack(data=list(dsfw=final.agg$dsfw.impute100), 
                      A=list(A.estimate, 1),
             effects=list(field.indices,data.frame(enso=final.agg$enso2,intercept=1)),
             tag='est')

formula <- (dsfw ~ 0 + intercept  +enso+ f(field, model=spde, group=field.group, control.group=list(model="ar1")))
######

result =inla(formula,
         data=inla.stack.data(stk,spde=spde),
         family="gaussian",
         control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stk), compute=TRUE),
         control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=FALSE),
         control.inla = list(reordering = "metis"))

messages.subject: Re: Is there a way to extract spatial structure matrix from SPDE approach?
parts:
Sorry I think I should rephrase this question. Using 

inla.spde2.precision(spde,theta=c(0,0))

I can extract a precision matrix for all vertices (I have 101 in this case). But, what I really want is a precision matrix for 36 original locations. Is there a way to get it?

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: Is there a way to extract spatial structure matrix from SPDE approach?
parts:
The precision for the "original points" is a dense matrix. Perhaps you can describe what it is you want to do with it, and/or what it is you want to compute from it? For gmrfs, there are usually different formulas to the ones used in covariance matrix calculations, to obtain the same conceptual quantity.

Finn
